en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a religious complex on a mountain, surrounded by alpine scenery with steep hills and coniferous forests. The central building is a church with a prominent bell tower, and several other buildings are clustered around it. The text is in Slovenian and there is handwriting on the lower part. The bottom left corner has the producer's imprint, indicating it was published in Innsbruck.
